notes: Aviator Trail is now a desktop app only, on Windows and Mac. An old browser version is removed when you install this one.
Ending videos: every career ends with its own short video. Retirements play their song on through the summary.
Your look from the setup screen carries through the game: long hair for a woman, a paper bag or animal head for Prefer not to say
Redrawn hair, and fixed airliners (engines under the wings, better tails)
Update now built in: it downloads the new installer, checks it and opens it. Saves carry on.
